management.name: Gregory Crowe
management.html:
Mr. Crowe has over 30 years’ experience in the exploration and mining sector. This includes extensive exposure to precious and base metal projects throughout North and South America, Asia and Africa. Mr. Crowe has worked with major mining companies and has served as a Director and Executive of several junior and development stage resource companies.

From 2002 until late 2015, Mr. Crowe was President and CEO of Entrée Gold Inc. He was instrumental in transforming Entrée from an early stage exploration play to one with an advanced development-mining project in joint-venture with Rio Tinto and its partner company, Turquoise Hill Resources. Over $12 billion has been slated towards production at Oyu Tolgoi, including Entrée’s JV project. In connection with the development of Entrée, Mr. Crowe played a key role in raising over $200 million, acquiring an Australian junior company for the procurement of a large copper project in Nevada and completing several other acquisitions and transactions.

Mr. Crowe’s key role in helping to bring about this highly successful development story attests to his ability to not only build companies, but to successfully navigate political and partnership issues and to strategically maneuver through cyclical variations in commodity markets.

management.name: Carmen Amezquita
management.html: Carmen Amezquita is a Chartered Professional Accountant (CPA, CA) with a strong corporate, financial, and accounting background and over fifteen years of experience in the mining industry. Ms. Amezquita has worked as the Chief Financial Officer and Controller of several public companies in the mining industry as well as in the audit and assurance group at PricewaterhouseCoopers. She holds a Bachelor of Arts degree from UBC and has a Diploma in Accounting from the UBC Sauder School of Business.

management.name: Raul Diaz
management.html: Mr. Diaz is an exploration geologist with 35 years of experience, much of it with Penoles where he discovered several mines including the Mezcala/Bermejal deposit, which is part of Goldcorp’s Los Filos operation in Mexico, and Capajorco in Peru. He also spearheaded Penoles’ internationalization by opening and managing the Peruvian subsidiary until 1999. He has served as V.P. Exploration and Director of First Mining Finance, a successor company of Sundance Minerals Ltd. that he cofounded in 2008. Raul received a Geological Engineering degree from the University of Mexico and master degrees from the University of Arizona and Cleveland State University.

management.name: Chris Osterman
management.role: BSc Mining Eng., MSc Geol. Eng., PhD Geology – Advisor
management.html: Dr. Osterman has thirty years’ experience in both metal production and exploration in North and South America, Africa, and Asia and is currently CEO and Director of First Mining Finance TSX-V:FF . Most recently, Dr. Osterman played an integral role in the discovery and development of the San Jose silver deposit in Oaxaca, Mexico; and the Zuun Mod molybdenum deposit in Mongolia. Dr. Osterman’s area of expertise lies in new project reconnaissance and exploration strategy. Dr. Osterman completed a PhD at the Colorado School of Mines focusing on sediment-hosted copper deposits in Namibia.

directors.name: Luke Norman
directors.html: Luke Norman is a seasoned growth executive with over 15 years of experience in the venture capital markets. He has been responsible for the direct capital raises in excess of $300M. Mr. Norman began his capital markets career at Ord O’Connor Grieve, New Zealand then worked for 4 years with Canaccord Capital Corp before moving on to the private investment industry. In recent years, Mr. Norman has operated a consultancy company to the metals and mining industry. He also co-founded Gold Standard Ventures Corp., a TSX-V and NYSE Market listed gold exploration company. Additioanlly, Mr. Norman co-founded and was formerly a director of Stratton Resources Inc.

directors.name: Barry Girling
directors.html: Mr. Girling has been active in various aspects of mineral exploration since 1977. He couples his geological understanding with a B.Com. Finance degree (U.B.C. 1990) to provide consulting services to a number of TSX Venture Exchange companies. He has strong capital markets experience gained as a founder and director of Foundation Resources Inc. and Search Minerals Inc. Mr. Girling was also a director of Roxgold Inc. from August 2006 through September 2102 and completed the re-organization of Roxgold Inc. as well as the acquisition of its Burkina Faso gold property. Aside from BRS, Mr. Girling was President and CEO of Birch Hill Gold Corporation from November 2012 until it amalgamated with Canoe Mining Ventures in June of 2014. He continues as a director of I-Minerals Inc. and Kiska Metals Corporation.

directors.name: Ken Engquist
directors.html:
Ken Engquist is a mining executive with 30 years of leadership experience advancing mineral projects from early-stage exploration through start-up and operations. He has overseen technical studies, permitting, stakeholder engagement, and operational execution, while also contributing to financing and M&A strategies across the mine development sector.

Ken recently served as CEO of Intrepid Metals and held COO roles at Western Copper and Gold and First Mining Gold, where he led the advancement of diverse project portfolios. His development work includes Nevsun’s Timok copper project, South32’s Hermosa zinc project, and Tinka Resources’ Ayawilca zinc project. Earlier in his career, he held senior roles at Rio Tinto and AngloGold Ashanti, managing large-scale capital projects and operations.

He currently serves as a Director and Board Advisor to several public and private organizations and holds a B.Sc. in Engineering from Michigan Technological University.
